Instructions:
	Domain: retail
	Reason for call:
		You recently faced a financial issue and want to cancel or return all possible orders. First, cancel the orders that haven't arrived yet. Then, return everything from the orders that have been delivered — you don't remember exactly which items you ordered, so ask the agent to list them before proceeding with the returns.
	Known info:
		You are Amelia, and you have two emails: silva7872@example.com and amelia.silva7872@example.com. You live in Philadelphia, and you are a loyal customer.
	Task instructions:
		You are now emotional and a bit stressed out. You like to talk a lot and explain your situation.

turns.thought: Hi! How can I help you today?
turns.execution_output:
User: Hi… thank you. I’m Amelia, and I’m sorry, I’m just really stressed out right now. I recently ran into some unexpected financial trouble, and I need to get things under control as much as I can.

So I need to cancel any orders I have that haven’t arrived yet, and then I want to return everything from the orders that have already been delivered. The problem is, I honestly can’t remember exactly what I ordered in each of those orders—it’s all been such a blur with everything going on. Could you please look up my orders and list out the items for me before we start the returns?

I live in Philadelphia and I’ve always been a loyal customer, so I’m really hoping you can help me with this. I might have used more than one email address when ordering, but I’m not sure which one is connected to the orders…

turns.thought:
Hi Amelia — I’m sorry you’re going through a stressful time, and I’ll do what I can to help.

Before I can look up your orders, I need to verify your identity. Could you please provide either:

- the **email address** associated with your orders, or
- your **last name** and **ZIP code** (since you mentioned Philadelphia)?

Once I have one of those, I can look up your account and list your orders and items for you.
turns.execution_output:
User: Oh, yes, of course—I completely understand you need to verify who I am. I’m so sorry, I’m just a little all over the place today. I don’t actually have my ZIP code memorized right now; I know I’m in Philadelphia, but with everything going on I just can’t seem to recall it. 

However, I do have a couple of email addresses I’ve used when ordering over the years, since I’ve been a loyal customer for a long time. The two emails are **silva7872@example.com** and **amelia.silva7872@example.com**. I’m honestly not sure which one is linked to the recent orders, so could you please check both for me? 

Once you can see my orders, could you please list out the items for me? I want to return everything from the orders that have already been delivered, but I don’t remember exactly what I got, so I really need to see the list before we do the returns. And for anything that hasn’t arrived yet, please cancel those orders immediately. Thank you so much for being patient with me.
